mapper.select:
select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Start_Time as secStartTime, sec.Sec_Bidding_Cycle as secBiddingCycle, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Other_Valuation as secOtherValuation, sec.Sec_Pricing_Method as secPricingMethod, sec.Sec_Trading_Place as secTradingPlace, sec.Sec_Money as secMoney, sec.Sec_Contracting_department as secContractingDepartment, c1.C_Name as dManageConsulName, c2.C_Name as dAgentUnitName, c3.C_Name as dPersonName, c4.C_Name as tendereeName, c5.C_Name as dEntrustedCpyName, c6.C_Name as secAgencyName, c1.C_Abbreviation as dManageConAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as dAgentAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as dPersonAbbName, c4.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, c5.C_Abbreviation as dEntrustedCpyAbbName, c7.C_Name as dCname, dp1.D_Name as dDname, u1.U_Name as dPmName,
sd.* from Sec_Document sd left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=sd.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=sd.D_Manage_Consul left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=sd.D_Agent_Unit left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id=sd.D_Person left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c5 on c5.C_Id=sd.D_Entrusted_Cpy left join Sys_Company c6 on c6.C_Id=sec.Sec_Agency left join Sys_Company c7 on c7.C_Id=sd.D_Cid left join Sys_Department dp1 on dp1.D_Id=sd.D_Did left join Sys_User u1 on u1.U_Id=sd.D_Pm_Id where sd.Sec_Id=#{secId}

select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Start_Time as secStartTime, sec.Sec_Bidding_Cycle as secBiddingCycle, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Other_Valuation as secOtherValuation, sec.Sec_Pricing_Method as secPricingMethod, sec.Sec_Trading_Place as secTradingPlace, sec.Sec_Money as secMoney, sec.Sec_Contracting_department as secContractingDepartment, sec.Sec_Section_Classify as secSectionClassify, dp.D_Name as secContractingDepartmentName, c1.C_Name as dManageConsulName, c2.C_Name as dAgentUnitName, c3.C_Name as dPersonName, c4.C_Name as tendereeName, c5.C_Name as dEntrustedCpyName, c6.C_Name as secAgencyName, c1.C_Abbreviation as dManageConAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as dAgentAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as dPersonAbbName, c4.C_Abbreviation as tendereeAbbName, c5.C_Abbreviation as dEntrustedCpyAbbName, c7.C_Name as dCname, dp1.D_Name as dDname, u1.U_Name as dPmName, pre.p_Name as pName,
sd.* from Sec_Document sd left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=sd.Sec_Id left join Sys_Department dp on dp.D_Id=sec.Sec_Contracting_department left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=sd.D_Manage_Consul left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=sd.D_Agent_Unit left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id=sd.D_Person left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join SYS_Company c5 on c5.C_Id=sd.D_Entrusted_Cpy left join Sys_Company c6 on c6.C_Id=sec.Sec_Agency left join Sys_Company c7 on c7.C_Id=sd.D_Cid left join Sys_Department dp1 on dp1.D_Id=sd.D_Did left join Sys_User u1 on u1.U_Id=sd.D_Pm_Id left join pre_project pre on pre.p_id=sd.P_id where sd.D_Id=#{dId}

sql.if: and (case when sd.P_Id is null then sp.P_Id else sd.P_Id end) = #{params.pId}

mapper.select: select ${selectClause} from Sec_Document mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id=mn.D_Person left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.D_Manage_Consul left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.D_Agent_Unit left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_Id=mn.D_Entrusted_Cpy left join Sys_Company c7 on c7.C_Id=mn.D_Cid left join Sys_Department dp1 on dp1.D_Id=mn.D_Did left join Sys_User u1 on u1.U_Id=mn.D_Pm_Id left join pre_project pre on pre.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre on dpre.D_Id = pre.p_Competent_Department left join Sec_Bidding_Plan sbp on sbp.Bp_Id=sec.Bp_Id left join ( select sp1.Sec_Id, sp1.P_ID, pro1.P_Name, pro1.p_Category, pro1.P_Build_Model, dpre1.D_Name from Sec_Project sp1 inner join pre_project pro1 on pro1.P_Id = sp1.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre1 on dpre1.D_Id = pro1.p_Competent_Department where not exists ( select 1 from Sec_Project sp2 inner join pre_project pro2 on pro2.P_Id = sp2.P_Id where sp2.Sec_Id = sp1.Sec_Id and pro2.P_Create_Time > pro1.P_Create_Time )) sp on sp.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id ${authSql}

select count(1) from Sec_Document mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join pre_project pre on pre.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join Sec_Bidding_Plan sbp on sbp.Bp_Id=sec.Bp_Id left join ( select sp1.Sec_Id, sp1.P_ID, pro1.P_Name, pro1.p_Category, pro1.P_Build_Model, dpre1.D_Name from Sec_Project sp1 inner join pre_project pro1 on pro1.P_Id = sp1.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre1 on dpre1.D_Id = pro1.p_Competent_Department where not exists ( select 1 from Sec_Project sp2 inner join pre_project pro2 on pro2.P_Id = sp2.P_Id where sp2.Sec_Id = sp1.Sec_Id and pro2.P_Create_Time > pro1.P_Create_Time )) sp on sp.Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id ${authSql}

choose.when: and ( (case when pre.P_Name is null then sp.P_Name else pre.P_Name end) is null or (case when pre.P_Name is null then sp.P_Name else pre.P_Name end) = '' )
choose.otherwise:
and (case when pre.P_Name is null then sp.P_Name else pre.P_Name end) in
#{pName}

choose.when: and ( (case when pre.P_Category is null then sp.p_Category else pre.P_Category end) is null or (case when pre.P_Category is null then sp.p_Category else pre.P_Category end) = '' )
choose.otherwise:
and (case when pre.P_Category is null then sp.p_Category else pre.P_Category end) in
#{pCategory}

mapper.select: select count(1) from Sec_Document sd left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=sd.Sec_Id left join ( select sp1.Sec_Id, sp1.P_ID, pro1.P_Name, pro1.p_Category, pro1.P_Build_Model, dpre1.D_Name from Sec_Project sp1 inner join pre_project pro1 on pro1.P_Id = sp1.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre1 on dpre1.D_Id = pro1.p_Competent_Department where not exists ( select 1 from Sec_Project sp2 inner join pre_project pro2 on pro2.P_Id = sp2.P_Id where sp2.Sec_Id = sp1.Sec_Id and pro2.P_Create_Time > pro1.P_Create_Time )) sp on sp.Sec_Id = sd.Sec_Id where 1=1

select count(1) from Sec_Document sd left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=sd.Sec_Id left join ( select sp1.Sec_Id, sp1.P_ID, pro1.P_Name, pro1.p_Category, pro1.P_Build_Model, dpre1.D_Name from Sec_Project sp1 inner join pre_project pro1 on pro1.P_Id = sp1.P_Id left join SYS_Department dpre1 on dpre1.D_Id = pro1.p_Competent_Department where not exists ( select 1 from Sec_Project sp2 inner join pre_project pro2 on pro2.P_Id = sp2.P_Id where sp2.Sec_Id = sp1.Sec_Id and pro2.P_Create_Time > pro1.P_Create_Time )) sp on sp.Sec_Id = sd.Sec_Id where 1=1
mapper.sql: ( select sd.D_Name from Pre_Project pro left join Sec_Project sp on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id left join Sys_Department sd on sd.D_Id=pro.P_Competent_Department where sd.D_Name is not null and sp.Sec_Id=sec.Sec_Id limit 1 ) as pCompetentDepartmentName,

(select wm_concat(P_Id) from Sec_Project where Sec_Id=sd.Sec_Id) as pId, (select wm_concat(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=sd.Sec_Id) as pName,

sql.if: and (select wm_concat(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=sd.Sec_Id) like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')
and ( CASE WHEN sd.D_New_Bid_Time is not null THEN to_char(sd.D_New_Bid_Time,'yyyy-MM') ELSE to_char(sd.D_Bid_Time,'yyyy-MM') END ) = #{params.dBidMonYear}

mapper.sql: (select string_agg(P_Id,',') from Sec_Project where Sec_Id = mn.Sec_Id) as pId, (select string_agg(pro.P_Name,',') from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) as pName,

sql.if: and (select string_agg(pro.P_Name,',') from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id) like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')
and ( CASE WHEN sd.D_New_Bid_Time is not null THEN to_char(sd.D_New_Bid_Time,'yyyy-MM') ELSE to_char(sd.D_Bid_Time,'yyyy-MM') END ) = #{params.dBidMonYear}

mapper.sql: (select GROUP_CONCAT(P_Id) from Sec_Project where Sec_Id=sd.Sec_Id) as pId, (select GROUP_CONCAT(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=sd.Sec_Id) as pName,

sql.if: and (select GROUP_CONCAT(pro.P_Name) from Sec_Project sp left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=sp.P_Id where sp.Sec_Id=sd.Sec_Id) like concat('%',#{params.pName},'%')
and ( CASE WHEN sd.D_New_Bid_Time is not null THEN date_format(sd.D_New_Bid_Time,'%Y-%m') ELSE date_format(sd.D_Bid_Time,'%Y-%m') END ) = #{params.dBidMonYear}
